scope: Source-budget evidence and acceptance-boundary correction, not numerical execution or figure certification
short_budget_excerpt: The RALM uses $I_{\mathrm{out}}=30$ outer iterations with an inner RCG solver capped at $I_{\mathrm{RCG}}=4000$ iterations per outer loop.
reported_outer_early_stop: step <= 1e-10 AND epsilon <= epsilon_min; an early-stop option, not a requirement that forbids completing the prescribed 30-outer budget
reported_multistart_selection: run 6000 random initializations and report the best feasible solution

unreported_initial_values_source_check.scope: Complete manuscript search of every lambda, multiplier and initialization occurrence, not just the numerical paragraph
unreported_initial_values_source_check.eta_initial_requirement: Initialize eta^(0), phi^(0), theta^(0), Xi^(0) within their respective manifolds; no numerical eta0 value supplied
unreported_initial_values_source_check.lambda_initial_requirement: lambda^(0) in R^K, supplied as an algorithm input; no numerical lambda0 value supplied
unreported_initial_values_source_check.numerical_settings_distinction: rho0=1 and lambda bounds [0,1e10] are specified, but lambda0 and eta0 values are not
unreported_initial_values_source_check.initialization_trial_authorization_scope: Disclosed WORK controls only; no claim of recovered author initialization; original random phase/scheduling draws preserved, no physical gain/reference fitting, no later eta block update replacement

numerical_acceptance_boundaries: A final original-problem constrained KKT certificate does not certify earlier capped inner ALM solves.
Increasing the 4000 cap can be a separately labeled work diagnostic, never undisclosed original-paper reproduction.
An extended diagnostic must retain the genuine original4000 failure and prove its full4000 trajectory is the exact same prefix, not resume from a capped state with reset PR memory.
Completing30 outers does not require the optional early-stop AND condition, but inner precision, primal feasibility, dual feasibility and complementarity remain independently checked.
Neither a lower objective change, a feasible eta, a passing final KKT nor a different multistart survivor may overwrite an inner cap/failure record.
